title: Freud's 1895 dream foreshadowing his oral cancer

tellings.quote: a dream he had in 1895 um famous dream and he spent like 14 pages of his his Landmark book

plain: Eric Wargo, a writer who studies dreams that seem to predict the future, talks about a famous dream that Sigmund Freud, the founder of psychoanalysis, had in Vienna in 1895. Freud spent about 14 pages on it in his landmark book The Interpretation of Dreams. Wargo reads it as a glimpse of the mouth cancer Freud was found to have decades later, which would mean dreams can reach ahead in time.
